title: Take shorter showers
explanation: Shower water use grows with every minute. Set a timer or play one song and aim to finish before it ends.
benefit: Lower water use, and lower water-heating costs if your shower uses a geyser.

title: Turn off the tap when it is not needed
explanation: Turn the tap off while brushing teeth, lathering hands or scrubbing dishes.
benefit: Avoids water running straight down the drain.

title: Wash dishes in a basin
explanation: Fill one basin to wash and a second to rinse, instead of rinsing each item under a running tap.
benefit: Uses a fixed, smaller amount of water.

title: Run full laundry loads
explanation: Wait until you have a full load where practical, or use the machine's half-load setting.
benefit: Fewer cycles for the same amount of washing.

title: Check for leaks
explanation: Note your water meter reading before bed and again in the morning, with no water used overnight. If the reading changed, there may be a leak. Contact a qualified plumber to repair it.
benefit: Finds water that is lost without being used.

title: Water the garden at cooler times
explanation: Water early in the morning or in the evening, aim at the roots, and use mulch to keep soil moist. Collect rinse water for plants where safe.
benefit: Less water lost to evaporation in a dry climate.

title: Switch off unnecessary lights
explanation: Turn lights off when you leave a room and use daylight where you can.
benefit: Removes hours of lighting that nobody is using.

title: Use LED bulbs
explanation: Replace incandescent and halogen bulbs with LEDs when they fail.
benefit: LEDs use much less power for the same brightness.

title: Manage the geyser safely
explanation: Use the geyser switch or a timer so water is heated before you need it, rather than all day. Do not open the geyser or change its thermostat yourself; ask a qualified electrician.
benefit: Heating water is often one of the largest household electricity uses.

title: Boil only what you need
explanation: Fill the kettle with the amount of water you will use, keeping above the minimum line.
benefit: Less energy spent heating unused water.

title: Run full washing-machine loads
explanation: Full loads on a cold or eco cycle where suitable for the fabric.
benefit: Most washing energy goes into heating water.

title: Spot standby power
explanation: TVs, decoders, chargers and microwaves can draw power when idle. Switch them off at the wall when not in use, if the device allows it.
benefit: Removes a small but constant draw.
